calibration_sources: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Enterprise Tool Gateway & Semantic Tool Retrieval Benchmarks
LangGraph / Temporal Durable Agent Execution & Human-in-the-Loop Checkpointing Patterns
LLMCompiler / Planner-Executor Small-Large Model Collaboration & Append-Only KV Cache Optimization

workload.enterprise_scenario: Enterprise IT & Supply-Chain Automation Agent (8-Step Workflow across 180 Enterprise APIs/MCP Tools, 200,000 Executions/Month)
workload.target_sla: Task Completion Rate >= 92.0%, P99 Workflow Latency <= 6.5 Seconds, 100% Durable Crash/Approval Recovery
workload.key_architectural_insights: Never stuff >15 tools into a single prompt; use dynamic Top-8 MCP tool retrieval + Planner (70B) / Executor (8B) split + strictly append-only history for 94% KV cache reuse.

tiers.name: Tier 1: 单体巨型 Prompt 全量塞入 180 个工具定义 + 开放式循环 (每步 3.6万 Token 爆炸)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Monolithic Prompt with All 180 Tool Schemas + Unbounded ReAct Loop
tiers.agent_architecture: All 180 JSON Tool Schemas (36K Tokens) Injected on Every Step -> 312K Input Tokens/Workflow
tiers.recommended_for: Anti-pattern: >20 tools in one prompt causes severe tool-selection confusion and quadratic token bloat.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 无状态内存多 Agent 拆分 + 串行工具调用 (Pod 重启或人工审批即丢失全部进度)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Stateless In-Memory Multi-Agent + Serial Tool Calls (No Durable Checkpointing)
tiers.agent_architecture: 5 Domain Sub-Agents in Volatile Python RAM + Sequential Tool Execution + Frontier Model on Every Step
tiers.recommended_for: Short-lived local demos without human-in-the-loop approval gates or high-concurrency SLA requirements.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 持久化状态图机 (LangGraph/Temporal) + MCP 动态 Top-8 工具检索 + 并行工具扇出
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Durable State Machine + Dynamic Top-8 MCP Tool Retrieval + Parallel Tool Fan-Out
tiers.agent_architecture: Postgres/Redis Step Checkpointer + Semantic Top-8 MCP Tool Filter (1.6K Tokens) + asyncio.gather Parallel Tools
tiers.recommended_for: Enterprise workflow standard requiring durable human approval resume and clean MCP tool governance.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 大小模型分层协同 (70B/R1 规划 + 8B 蒸馏执行) + 追加式前缀缓存 + 并行 MCP 网关
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Hierarchical Planner-Executor (70B/R1 + 8B SLM) + Append-Only Prefix Cache + Parallel MCP
tiers.agent_architecture: 70B/R1 DAG Planner (22% Steps) + Distilled 8B Tool Executor (78% Steps) + 94% Append-Only KV Cache Hit
tiers.recommended_for: High-scale production enterprise Agentic platform: 6.76x faster execution, 95.6% success rate, and 95.1% lower TCO.
